meta.githubCommitMessage:
Continue CQC: original MGS3 sprites, MG2 stories and canonical combat

Share the verified CQC runtime between the standalone game and the Shadow Codec
Ops tab. Add native Pain, Fear, End and Fury bodies, source-measured launch
origins, hornet/bolt/fire artwork and twelve original MG2 narrative paintings.
Correct masked Pain finishers, Mosin ammunition and Red Blaster grenade/wire
equipment; fill three PSP stage camera margins without replacing old layers.

Validation: CQC 1227 checks, sprite tools 39 tests, Shadow 705 tests plus build,
and 382 browser checks across both mounts. Independent preservation review:
236 assertions, no failures. Historical source bytes, rejected native attempts
and preliminary verification failures remain preserved in the review bundle.
